ground_truth_source: FActScore paper's own released human annotations (Min et al., 2023) — InstructGPT/ChatGPT/PerplexityAI biographies of 183 Wikipedia entities, sentence-by-sentence S/NS/IR labels by human annotators. See sense_data.factscore_labeled module docstring for provenance.
method: claim_supported_threshold swept against direct human S/NS labels; fraction thresholds swept against human_supported_fraction (n_S/(n_S+n_NS)) binarized at ground_truth_high/low_fraction, using this project's own sentence-level supported_fraction as the predictor — see module docstring for the honest limitations of this proxy
